reference_sql:
WITH units AS (SELECT ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY ol.product_id),
checks AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01' GROUP BY product_id)
SELECT p.product_name, u.units, COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN units u ON u.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'

solver.query:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  GROUP BY ol.product_id
), checks AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.product_name, s.units, COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN sold s ON s.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
